targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime('2026-11-13 00:00:00','UTC') + t*600 AS time, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(0-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `1`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(1-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `2`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(2-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `4`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(3-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `8`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(4-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `16`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(5-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `32`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(6-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `64`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(7-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `128` FROM (SELECT number AS t FROM numbers(30)) ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime('2026-11-13 00:00:00','UTC') + t*600 AS time, toString(toFloat64(pow(2,b))) AS le, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(b-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS count FROM (SELECT number AS t FROM numbers(30)) CROSS JOIN (SELECT number AS b FROM numbers(8)) ORDER BY time, b

SELECT toDateTime('2026-11-13 00:00:00','UTC') + t*600 AS time, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(0-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `fast`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(1-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `ok`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(2-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `slow`, toUInt32(round(100*exp(-pow(3-3-sin(t/4)*1.5,2)/2))) AS `very slow` FROM (SELECT number AS t FROM numbers(30)) ORDER BY time
